title: Evaluating Priority Dispatch for Premium Membership in On-demand Taxi-sharing
abstract: arXiv:2610.37011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we analyze the dispatch-level feasibility of introducing premium membership into an on-demand taxi-sharing service using a sequential optimal insertion method. We propose two dispatch-level methods: deadline shortening for premium users, and deadline shortening with dedicated premium vehicles. We compare them with a baseline dispatch method through SUMO-based simulations under three demand scenarios: steady uniform demand, time-varying demand with a peak period, and urban-focused demand with concentrated peak traffic. Our results show that the suitable priority mechanism depends on operating conditions and premium ratio, suggesting that condition-dependent method switching may provide premium benefits while keeping non-premium-user burden smaller for overall optimization.

translated_title: 评估按需共享出租车服务中面向高级会员的优先调度机制
translated_abstract: 本文使用顺序最优插入方法，分析了在按需共享出租车服务中引入高级会员的调度层面可行性。我们提出了两种调度层面的方法：一是缩短高级用户的截止时间，二是缩短截止时间并配备专用高级车辆。通过基于SUMO的仿真，我们在三种需求场景下将这两种方法与基线调度方法进行比较：稳定均匀需求、具有高峰时段的时变需求，以及高峰交通集中在城市区域的需求。结果表明，合适的优先机制取决于运营条件和高级会员比例，这意味着根据条件动态切换调度方法，可以在整体优化的同时为高级会员提供优先权益，并将非高级用户的负担保持在较低水平。
tldr: 通过SUMO仿真评估按需共享出租车中两种高级会员优先调度策略，发现最优优先机制取决于运营条件与会员比例，条件自适应的方法切换可在保障高级会员权益的同时降低非会员负担。
en_tdlr: This paper uses SUMO simulations to evaluate two priority dispatch strategies for premium members in on-demand taxi-sharing, showing that the optimal mechanism depends on operating conditions and premium ratio, and condition-dependent switching can deliver premium benefits while minimizing the burden on non-premium users.
